request.deadline: 18-month funding period with milestones from Q3 2026 through 2027
deliverables: Not-for-profit entity established or host-organization agreement signed, transition architecture and migration plan published, and public usage dashboard live in Q3 2026
Board election held via on-chain voting under published rules and elected board assumes mandate in Q4 2026
Public API traffic for mainnet, preview, and preprod served by the new stack, Blockfrost IP transferred to the governing entity, and service performance maintained in Q1 2027
Public sustainability consultation and proposal for long-term model published in Q2-Q3 2027
Public API operated with minimum 99% monthly uptime SLA and quarterly technical and budget reports during 2027
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost transition administered through Intersect and CDH-related contract arrangements
request.what: Transition Blockfrost into a free, community-governed public good under an independent not-for-profit and fund 18 months of transition and operations.

claims.claim: Blockfrost provides a hosted REST interface that lets developers read from and interact with Cardano without running their own node.
The proposal says Blockfrost adoption in the Cardano Foundation developer ecosystem survey rose from 39.3% in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025, with links to the survey pages.
The proposal says Blockfrost served 781k unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 requests per second, and over 7 TB of API data last month.
The proposal says more than 50% of all Cardano transactions are submitted through Blockfrost in most epochs.
The proposal says more than 100 Icebreakers have joined the decentralized Blockfrost operator effort.

The proposal states that 90% of all Cardano traffic served through the Blockfrost API comes from the free tier and that the current commercial model has struggled to finance the public-good operation.
The proposal commits to transferring Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domains, and associated assets into a community-governed not-for-profit entity.
The proposal requests 9,832,979 ADA, valued at $1,868,266 using $0.19 per ADA, for 18 months of transition and operations.
The budget allocates 79.1% to staffing for six roles, 19.3% to operations and infrastructure, and 1.6% to legal and accounting.
The proposal says project delivery will be governed by an off-chain legal contract, milestone acceptance, Intersect delivery assurance, and a third-party assurer.

summary: The document presents a large treasury request to convert Blockfrost from a commercial service into a community-governed not-for-profit public API, citing developer survey adoption links, asserted usage scale, a milestone plan, budget allocations, governance structure, IP transfer commitment, and delivery assurance arrangements.
